paragraphs: R' Shmuel bar Yanai. See the entry R' Shmuel bar Unia.[^1]

notes.text: Yanai (ינאי) and Unia (אוניא) remain distinct patronymics with conventional English vowels. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
